authoringStatement.statement: Expected beat fractions, PPQ ticks, gate ticks, loop intersections, pitch projections, refusals, limit seams, and law relations were authored from checked-in contracts and hand calculation before a P0 production compiler exists. No compilePlaybackPlan output, audio render, MIDI encoder, generated artifact, or legacy runtime supplied an expected value.

authorities.title: Playback layer and shared-plan architecture
sourceRefs: docs/ARCHITECTURE.md Module ownership and Architecture invariants

claims.text: Playback is pure, imports domain and theory types only, and makes no audio, UI, storage, export, browser, model, or network call.
Audio and MIDI consume the same recursively immutable plan unchanged.
Float seconds appear only at the audio scheduling boundary; P0 owns exact beats and ticks.
Compiler, request, binding, result, plan, event, policy, refusal, termination, and own-key identities are exact and versioned.
Every emitted event preserves event, section, measure, and global source ordinal identity.
Every failure returns one precedence-winning typed refusal and no partial plan.

authorities.title: F1 exact time, pitch, ID, meter, document, and stored-voicing laws

claims.text: Stored time is exact quarter-note rational data whose reduced denominator divides PPQ 960.
Manual and Frozen order, spelling, octave, and duplicate pitches round-trip exactly.
Meter capacity is beatsPerBar times four divided by beatUnit; partial and empty completion remain explicit.
Ordinary P0 requests contain only F3 ValidatedDocument values; malformed branded cases are explicit defensive near misses.
Custom chords are nonempty Manual or Frozen values and never automatic.
Empty, complete, pickup, and incomplete measure semantics have already been validated without repair.

authorities.title: T0 exact chord syntax and alias authority

claims.text: CM7 and CDelta7 parse to the same stored chord AST as Cmaj7 while source text remains exact input data.
Transposition witnesses use supported exact written chord symbols rather than display-only labels.

authorities.title: T1 exact resolved source, realization ID, role, and spelling authority

claims.text: A generated binding names one exact resolved source and one exact realization ID.
Diatonic transposition preserves exact written spelling and cannot be certified by MIDI equality alone.

authorities.title: V0 generated outcome and stored-bypass authority

claims.text: Generated binding holds one exact AutoVoicingRequest and an available candidate or typed V0 failure.
Manual and Frozen values arrive as an exact zero-generation StoredVoicingBypass.
Candidate family, realization, voice count, voice pitch records, and pitch array remain correlated.

authorities.title: Version-one loop, articulation, and velocity policy

claims.text: After loop clipping, gate ticks equal duration ticks minus min of 24 and duration ticks minus one.
Loop ranges are half-open, never clamped, restart start-overlaps, clip end-overlaps, and may contain only silence.
Every version-one event uses fixed velocity 96.

authorities.title: P0 deterministic timeline, work, memory, and collection limits

claims.text: Every public work and memory counter has an inclusive exact maximum and a test-seam maximum-plus-one refusal.
Absolute source time may equal but never exceed one million quarter-note beats.
Wall time cannot change plan membership, refusal, ordering, or termination.

authorities.title: Independent fixtures, laws, mutations, and anti-self-certification

claims.text: Production output never generates or updates an expected fixture.
Positive, near-miss, transposition, determinism, immutability, and mutation witnesses are reciprocal and stable.
Canonical bytes use frozen public key orders and no locale-sensitive ordering.

authorities.title: L-VOICE-01 manual-note reoptimization regression
sourceRefs: docs/LEGACY_AUDIT.md Manual voicing is not authoritative

claims.text: The rebuilt playback plan must preserve a user's exact Manual inversion, register, doubling, order, and spelling without optimizer rewrite.
